lines.say: acts like GnRH; given continuously, it shuts down sex hormones and pauses early puberty
testosterone surges briefly, then falls to castration levels, usually within 4 weeks
hormone-lowering therapy like it cut prostate cancer deaths (11 trials); PSA is tracked
eases endometriosis pain and lesions, and fibroid anemia before surgery (with iron)
can rise, with new or worse diabetes
blood fats can rise, so lipids are checked
ECG checked if at risk; heart attack, stroke and long QT linked in men, a risk called low
in children, LH or sex hormones, growth and bone age are checked
early testosterone surge can flare prostate cancer, even compressing the spinal cord
women lost about 6% spine density in a year without add-back, some lasting; also in men
hot flashes and sweats in about half or more of users
mood changes, depression and seizures; raised skull pressure in children

ask: How will we check my blood sugar, cholesterol and heart rhythm while I'm on it?
